credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Full-length portrait of O'Keeffe leaning against a large wooden stump on her portal at Ghost Ranch; her hair is pulled back from her face and she stares off towards viewer right; she is wearing a black wrap dress, her favorite belt - a black suede and sterling silver Taxco belt from Mexico, and the Alexander Calder brooch, ankles are crossed wearing tied flat leather shoes, a large cow skull hangs on the adobe wall adjacent to the windows- beneath is a pine shelf displaying large bone fragments and a collection of rocks
title: Georgia O'Keeffe on Ghost Ranch Portal
